turns.question: What was our win rate on the search leads that came in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no "win rate" metric; the closest is the Lead-to-booking rate (share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created, counted on the lead's creation day, the glossary's conversion), with Bookings and Leads as the related metrics. For search-channel leads created 1-30 September 2026, the lead-to-booking rate was 0.337 (33.7 %). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
